verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is that Mixpanel publishes a first-party "Identity" API (one of its OpenAPI specs) and an Ingestion API covering "user profile handling". That points to product-owned identity management, but nothing in the pack describes how users are identified across devices or how anonymous pre-signup events merge into an identified profile. missing for 10: documentation of cross-device identification, documented merging of anonymous activity into identified profiles (identify/alias/merge semantics), SDK-level identity methods, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can identify users across devices and merge anonymous pre-signup activity into their identified profile

citations.quote: Ingestion, Query, Raw Data Export, Identity, Service Accounts
APIs allowing for event-based tracking and user profile handling
